units.title: Unit 1 · Weekend Life
units.summary:
Conversation: How was your weekend? / It was great. We went to the amusement park. / How did you like the new roller coaster? / I was a little scared at first, but it was really exciting. / Did you have a good weekend? / Not really. I had a boring weekend. / I didn't do anything interesting.
Words: eat out at a restaurant, build a model plane, see a musical, sail on a boat, visit grandparents, write emails to friends, go to a water park, have a sleepover
Grammar: What did she do on the weekend? / She ate out at a restaurant. / Did he see a musical on the weekend? / Yes, he did. No, he didn't.
